metadata.repo_type_justification: Application source code with deployable entry point (Fastify server in src/), Dockerfile, and CloudFormation IaC (infra/ecs.yaml) scoped to a single ECS Fargate service.
metadata.archetype_justification: Owns a PostgreSQL database with CRUD operations on orders entity (create, get, delete, refund, cancel). Has user-specific data (customerId), entity status lifecycle (placed/shipped/cancelled/refunded), and write endpoints.

top_gaps.title: CI/CD Automation
top_gaps.gap: No CI/CD pipeline — all deployments manual
top_gaps.impact: Blocks safe, repeatable releases; primary trigger for Modern DevOps pathway

top_gaps.title: Integration Testing
top_gaps.gap: No automated tests found in repository
top_gaps.impact: No regression protection; changes carry high risk of undetected breakage

top_gaps.title: Async Messaging and Streaming
top_gaps.gap: No messaging — cross-service calls are fully synchronous
top_gaps.impact: Tight coupling to downstream services; cascading failure risk on timeout

top_gaps.title: Distributed Tracing
top_gaps.impact: Cannot trace requests across service boundaries; debugging production issues is guesswork

top_gaps.title: Async vs Sync Communication
top_gaps.gap: All inter-service communication is synchronous HTTP
top_gaps.impact: Cascading failure risk; refund and cancel operations block on downstream response

findings.title: Managed Databases — RDS configuration not verifiable from repo IaC
findings.description: PostgreSQL 15 on RDS (managed) per README documentation. Secrets Manager used for DB credentials. However, the RDS resource itself is not defined in this repository's IaC.
findings.gap: RDS instance not defined in this repo's IaC; cannot verify failover, encryption, or performance configuration.
findings.recommendation: Define the RDS instance in IaC within this repo to enable configuration verification and drift detection.

findings.title: Workflow Orchestration — multi-step operations lack managed orchestration
findings.description: The service has multi-step operations (refund: update DB then call payment processor; cancel: update DB then recall warehouse dispatch) implemented as sequential code with no dedicated orchestration service.
findings.gap: Multi-step operations (refund, cancel) lack structured orchestration — no retry logic, no compensation on partial failure.
findings.recommendation: Evaluate AWS Step Functions for the refund and cancel workflows to provide retry logic, error handling, and compensation.

findings.title: Async Messaging — no messaging for cross-service state changes
findings.description: No messaging or streaming infrastructure detected. Cross-service state changes (refund, cancel) are handled via synchronous calls with no event-driven decoupling.
findings.gap: No messaging where state changes cross service boundaries — tight synchronous coupling to payment processor and warehouse.
findings.recommendation: Introduce managed messaging (SQS or EventBridge) for the refund and cancel operations.

findings.title: Network Security — no managed networking services
findings.description: ECS service deployed in private subnets (AssignPublicIp: DISABLED). No managed networking services (VPC endpoints, PrivateLink) configured.
findings.gap: No VPC endpoints for service-to-AWS communication.
findings.recommendation: Add VPC endpoints for Secrets Manager, CloudWatch Logs, and ECR.

findings.title: API Entry Point — no load balancer or API gateway
findings.description: No API Gateway, ALB, or CloudFront defined in the IaC. The ECS service exposes port 3000 directly with no managed entry point.
findings.gap: No load balancer or API gateway — service lacks throttling, request validation, and centralized routing.
findings.recommendation: Add an ALB or API Gateway to provide health checking, throttling, TLS termination, and access control.

findings.title: Auto-Scaling — all capacity statically provisioned
findings.description: No auto-scaling configured. ECS service uses static DesiredCount: 2 with no scaling policy.
findings.gap: Cannot respond to traffic spikes or scale down during low demand.
findings.recommendation: Configure Application Auto Scaling for the ECS service with target tracking on CPU or request count.

findings.title: Backup and Recovery — no backup configuration
findings.description: No backup configuration found in IaC. RDS instance not defined in this repo so backup settings cannot be verified.
findings.gap: No backup configuration for the production database containing order data and customer PII.
findings.recommendation: Define RDS with backup_retention_period > 0 and PITR enabled. Add an AWS Backup plan.

findings.title: High Availability — Multi-AZ not verifiable
findings.description: ECS tasks distributed across subnet list (potentially multi-AZ) with DesiredCount: 2. RDS Multi-AZ configuration cannot be verified.
findings.gap: Cannot verify Multi-AZ for database. No ALB for cross-zone load distribution.
findings.recommendation: Define RDS with multi_az: true. Add ALB with cross-zone load balancing.

findings.title: Infrastructure as Code Coverage — partial, ~40-50%
findings.description: CloudFormation covers ECS cluster, task, service, secrets, IAM. Missing: RDS, ALB, VPC/networking, auto-scaling, monitoring, backup.
findings.gap: Significant infrastructure managed outside this repo's IaC — database, networking, load balancer, monitoring.
findings.recommendation: Extend IaC to cover all infrastructure this service depends on. Target 90%+ coverage.

findings.title: CI/CD Automation — no pipeline exists
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline configuration found. No GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, CodeBuild, or any pipeline definition.
findings.gap: No CI/CD automation — all deployments manual with no automated build, test, or deploy stages.
findings.recommendation: Establish a CI/CD pipeline with build, test, container build, and deploy stages.

findings.title: Async vs Sync — all inter-service communication synchronous
findings.description: All inter-service communication is synchronous HTTP. WarehouseClient makes blocking calls to downstream services for refund and cancel operations.
findings.gap: All communication synchronous HTTP with no async patterns. Cascading failure risk on downstream timeouts.
findings.recommendation: Introduce async communication for state-change propagation via SQS/EventBridge.

findings.title: Long-Running Process Handling — all operations synchronous
findings.description: Refund and cancel operations make synchronous calls to external services with no timeout management, no async job processing, no status polling.
findings.gap: All operations synchronous regardless of duration. No background job infrastructure.
findings.recommendation: Implement async job processing for refund and cancel: accept request, return 202, process asynchronously with status polling.

findings.title: API Versioning — no versioning strategy
findings.description: No API versioning. Endpoints use unversioned paths (/orders, /orders/{id}). No URL prefix, no version headers.
findings.gap: No versioning — breaking changes deployed directly to all consumers.
findings.recommendation: Adopt URL-based versioning (/v1/orders) or header-based versioning before the next breaking change.

findings.title: Service Discovery — environment variables only
findings.description: Service endpoints configured via environment variables (JWKS_URI, JWT_ISSUER). No dynamic service discovery.
findings.gap: Static endpoint configuration; no dynamic discovery for scaling or failover.
findings.recommendation: Adopt AWS Cloud Map for service-to-service discovery.

findings.title: Database Engine Version — not pinned in IaC
findings.description: README documents PostgreSQL 15 (not at EOL). Engine version not pinned in IaC since no RDS resource is defined in this repo.
findings.gap: Database engine version not codified in IaC, creating drift risk.
findings.recommendation: Define RDS instance in CloudFormation with explicit EngineVersion pinned to PostgreSQL 15.

findings.title: Encryption at Rest — no customer-managed KMS keys
findings.description: Secrets Manager encrypted with AWS-managed key. Database encryption cannot be verified. No explicit KMS key resources.
findings.gap: No customer-managed KMS keys; database encryption unknown.
findings.recommendation: Define customer-managed KMS key for RDS and Secrets Manager. Include RDS with StorageEncrypted: true.

findings.title: API Authentication — no API Gateway throttling layer
findings.description: JWT RS256 authentication on all endpoints with JWKS validation and role-based authorization. No API Gateway for throttling/WAF.
findings.gap: Authentication at application level only; no managed throttling or WAF protection.
findings.recommendation: Layer an API Gateway or ALB with WAF for throttling and DDoS protection.

findings.title: Centralized Identity — IdP integration without verifiable SSO
findings.description: JWT validation against remote JWKS endpoint with issuer/audience verification. Indicates centralized IdP integration.
findings.gap: Cannot verify SSO enablement from application code alone.
findings.recommendation: Document the centralized IdP integration. Consider adding Cognito resources to IaC.

findings.title: Secrets Management — no rotation configured
findings.description: Database password in Secrets Manager with auto-generated value. No plaintext credentials. But no rotation configured.
findings.gap: No automated rotation on database secret.
findings.recommendation: Configure automated rotation with a 30-day schedule using a Secrets Manager rotation Lambda.

findings.title: Compute Hardening — default base image, no scanning
findings.description: Container uses node:20-slim (not hardened). Runs as non-root. No vulnerability scanning configured.
findings.gap: Default base image with no hardening or vulnerability scanning.
findings.recommendation: Switch to hardened base image (Distroless/Chainguard). Enable ECR image scanning.

findings.title: Application Security Pipeline — no security scanning
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline exists, so no security scanning is integrated. No Dependabot, no SAST, no container scanning.
findings.gap: No security scanning tools configured. Vulnerabilities reach production undetected.
findings.recommendation: Add npm audit/Snyk for dependencies, Semgrep for SAST, ECR scanning for containers when establishing CI/CD.

findings.title: Distributed Tracing — not instrumented
findings.description: No OpenTelemetry SDK, no X-Ray SDK, no trace ID propagation across service boundaries.
findings.gap: Cannot trace requests across service boundaries. Debugging cross-service failures is guesswork.
findings.recommendation: Instrument OpenTelemetry with X-Ray exporter. Propagate traceparent headers to downstream calls.

findings.title: SLO Definitions — none defined
findings.description: No SLO definitions, no CloudWatch alarms, no error budget tracking. No formal definition of acceptable service levels.
findings.gap: No SLOs — cannot measure whether service meets user expectations.
findings.recommendation: Define SLOs for critical paths: p99 latency, error rate. Create CloudWatch alarms.

findings.title: Business Metrics — none published
findings.description: No custom business metrics. Only default Fargate infrastructure metrics available.
findings.gap: Cannot measure order throughput, refund patterns, or cancellation trends.
findings.recommendation: Publish custom CloudWatch metrics: orders_created, refunded, cancelled counts and order values.

findings.title: Anomaly Detection and Alerting — no alerting configured
findings.description: No CloudWatch alarms, no anomaly detection, no PagerDuty/OpsGenie integration. Service can fail silently.
findings.gap: No alerting — failures go undetected until users report problems.
findings.recommendation: Create alarms for ECS task health, 5xx error rate, p99 latency. Enable anomaly detection.

findings.title: Deployment Strategy — rolling only, no traffic shifting
findings.description: ECS uses DeploymentCircuitBreaker with rollback. Rolling deployment with health checks but no blue/green or canary.
findings.gap: No canary period — all tasks receive traffic immediately.
findings.recommendation: Integrate CodeDeploy with ECS for blue/green or canary deployments with traffic shifting.

findings.title: Integration Testing — no tests exist
findings.description: Vitest configured but no test files in repository. No unit, integration, contract, or e2e tests.
findings.gap: No automated tests. Changes carry high regression risk.
findings.recommendation: Write integration tests for order creation, retrieval, refund, cancel. Use testcontainers for DB tests.

findings.title: Incident Response — no runbooks or automation
findings.description: No runbooks, no SSM Automation, no self-healing patterns. Only ECS circuit breaker provides automated recovery.
findings.gap: No incident response automation. Response is entirely ad hoc.
findings.recommendation: Create runbooks for common failures. Implement SSM Automation for known remediation patterns.

findings.title: Observability Ownership — no dashboards or alarm ownership
findings.description: CloudWatch Logs configured for basic log collection. No dashboards, no alarms with owners, no CODEOWNERS.
findings.gap: No observability ownership. Monitoring is reactive with only basic log collection.
findings.recommendation: Create service dashboard. Define alarm owners. Add CODEOWNERS for infra/ directory.

findings.title: Resource Tagging — no tags on any resources
findings.description: No tags on any CloudFormation resources. No cost allocation, ownership, or environment tags.
findings.gap: Cannot track costs, identify ownership, or enforce budget controls.
findings.recommendation: Add consistent tags (Service, Team, Environment, CostCenter) to all CloudFormation resources.

evaluations.title: Managed Compute
evaluations.reason: All compute on ECS Fargate — fully managed, no EC2.

evaluations.title: Programming Languages
evaluations.reason: Node.js 20 + TypeScript 5.4 + Fastify 4.26 — modern language, framework, and runtime.

evaluations.title: Monolith vs Microservices
evaluations.reason: Independent microservice with clean layered architecture and typed interfaces.

evaluations.title: Unstructured Data Storage
evaluations.reason: Service stores structured data only; no unstructured data requirements identified.

evaluations.title: Unified Data Access Layer
evaluations.reason: All DB access centralized in OrderService class; single point of data contract.

evaluations.title: Stored Procedures and Schema Complexity
evaluations.reason: No stored procedures or proprietary SQL; all logic in application layer.

evaluations.title: Audit Logging
evaluations.reason: Application-level IaC only (ECS, Secrets Manager, IAM). CloudTrail is an account-level concern belonging in foundation infrastructure repo.
